def rule(a: int, b: int, c: int) -> bool:
    def is_odd(n: int) -> bool:
        return n % 2 != 0

    def is_even(n: int) -> bool:
        return n % 2 == 0

    all_odd = all(is_odd(x) for x in (a, b, c))
    all_even = all(is_even(x) for x in (a, b, c))
    consecutive = any(
        (a == b + 1 and b == c + 1) or
        (b == a + 1 and a == c + 1) or
        (c == a + 1 and a == b + 1) or
        (a == b - 1 and b == c - 1) or
        (b == a - 1 and a == c - 1) or
        (c == a - 1 and a == b - 1)
    )

    return all_odd or all_even or consecutive

    consecutive = (a == b + 1 and b == c + 1) or (a == b - 1 and b == c - 1) or \
